name: winwright-site
description: The public site for winwright — copy in one module, sections only render it.

scripts.generate: node scripts/product.mjs && node scripts/grammar.mjs && node scripts/format.mjs && node scripts/verbs.mjs && node scripts/project.mjs && node scripts/holes.mjs && node scripts/inapp.mjs && node scripts/messages.mjs
scripts.build: npm run generate && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/og-image.mjs && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs && npm run build:docs && node scripts/docs-twins.mjs && node scripts/docs-sitemap.mjs
scripts.prerender: vite build --ssr src/entry-server.tsx --outDir dist-server && node scripts/prerender.mjs
